profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-based public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions. According to its website, it makes lidar sensors for ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications, and says it partners with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle, and robotics companies worldwide, with mass-produced lidars delivered to customers in over 40 countries. It describes lidar as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, enabling features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), and says its sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving used by robotaxis and robobuses.

The company's own material positions it around physical AI and spatial intelligence as well as automotive sensing, with a stated focus on high-resolution 3D perception and safety and performance for the automotive industry. No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company in the data reviewed.
